content.short: Goldsand is the first Halal Ethereum staking protocol designed for over 1 billion Muslim users worldwide with a staking pool open to everyone.
content.description: Goldsand is the inaugural offering from InshAllah Network, delivering Halal Ethereum staking designed for more than a billion potential Muslim users worldwide. Its staking protocol screens for transactions considered impermissible under Shariah principles, ensuring that blocks proposed by Goldsand validators do not include income from prohibited activities like interest-related transactions. The staking pool welcomes participation from all interested users, making ethical crypto staking accessible to a broad audience.
